overall.summary: Deterministic contract is unscoped. 1 evidence-backed blocker(s); 3 advisory taste note(s).
overall.raw_summary: The HUD is functional but has several issues with spacing, alignment, and visual hierarchy that hinder readability and polish. Improvements are needed to ensure better task readiness and thematic consistency.

strengths: The HUD elements are generally placed in expected locations (e.g., minimap in the top-right corner, health bar at the bottom).
issues: The minimap is not aligned with the top-right corner of the screen, leaving an inconsistent margin.
The 'Floor 1' and timer panel is not optically centered at the top of the screen, creating a visual imbalance.
The 'Auto Abilities' panel is not aligned with the bottom edge of the screen, leaving an inconsistent gap.

strengths: The spacing between ability slots in the 'Auto Abilities' panel is consistent.
issues: The 'Auto Abilities' panel is cramped vertically, with insufficient padding between the text and the top/bottom edges of the panel.
The health bar and currency panel are too close to the bottom edge of the screen, leaving no breathing room.

strengths: The minimap and health bar are visually distinct and easy to locate.
issues: The 'Floor 1' and timer panel lacks emphasis and does not stand out as a key piece of information.
The 'Auto Abilities' panel does not clearly differentiate between active and inactive abilities, making it harder to scan quickly.

strengths: Text is crisp and legible, adhering to pixel art standards.
issues: The text in the 'Auto Abilities' panel is slightly small, which may hinder readability for some players.
The red highlight for selected abilities is subtle and could be more visually prominent.

strengths: Icons for currency and health are clear and recognizable.
issues: The minimap lacks any icons or markers, reducing its utility.
The 'Auto Abilities' panel does not use icons for abilities, relying solely on text, which reduces visual clarity.

strengths: The font is consistent and matches the pixel art style of the game.
issues: The text in the 'Floor 1' and timer panel is slightly misaligned within its container.
The 'Auto Abilities' panel text is cramped, with insufficient padding around the labels.

strengths: The overall aesthetic matches the pixel art style of the game.
issues: The 'Auto Abilities' panel feels overly sterile and lacks decorative elements to tie it into the game's theme.
The minimap's plain design does not align with the rest of the game's visual style.

blocking_findings: The minimap lacks any markers or icons, reducing its functionality.
recommended_fixes: Add padding to the 'Auto Abilities' panel to improve text readability.
Introduce markers or icons to the minimap to enhance its utility.
Increase the visual emphasis of the 'Floor 1' and timer panel to improve its hierarchy.
Add decorative elements to the 'Auto Abilities' panel to better integrate it into the game's theme.

precise_fixes.reason: Align the minimap closer to the top-right corner for consistency with other HUD elements.
Center the 'Floor 1' and timer panel at the top of the screen for better visual balance.
Add vertical padding to the 'Auto Abilities' panel to improve text readability.
Add breathing room between the health bar and the bottom edge of the screen.
